summary.en: A click on the editor's primary button and the interface evaporates around it layer by layer, outside in; the button alone glides to the centre of a dark frame, then lets go to the lock-up.
summary.zh: 点一下编辑器的主按钮，界面由外向内一层层蒸发；只剩按钮滑到暗场中央，再交给标志落版。

fits: The end of a product demo whose last action is the point (publish, ship, send): the action stays, everything else goes, then the name.
notFor: Products without a primary action in their UI; endings that should keep the product on screen.

overlaps.note: the lock-up alone; strip-away arrives at it by subtracting the UI around one button

intent.en: Everything but the one action falls away, so the viewer leaves with that action and the name behind it.
intent.zh: 除了那一个动作，其余都褪去：观众带走的是这个动作和它背后的名字。

content.en: The primary action's label (one word ≤ 10 chars), a document title ≤ 20 chars, a wordmark ≤ 16 chars, a mark; up to four screenshots for the editor's cards.
content.zh: 主操作按钮的文字（≤ 3 字），≤ 8 字的文档标题，≤ 6 字的字标，一个标志；编辑器里的卡片最多 4 张截图。

fits.zh: 最后一个动作就是重点的产品演示的结尾（发布、上线、发送）：动作留下，其余褪去，再落名字。

notFor.zh: 界面里没有主操作的产品；片尾要留住产品画面的。

pairs.note: a cursor-led demo ending on the same click

en: The button must be the action the film was about; any other button turns the ending into a random click.
zh: 按钮必须是全片讲的那个动作；换成别的按钮，结尾就成了随手一点。

upstream.name: 减法收尾
upstream.summary: 减法式收尾——点击 Publish 后整个编辑器 UI 从外围到中心层层错峰蒸发，黑场上只剩那颗按钮滑到屏心放大，按钮再淡出交棒字标定版
upstream.use: "发布/完成"语义的 outro；想讲"一键之后一切复杂性消失"的产品收尾
upstream.energy: 中（前段安静操作，中段持续退场，无瞬时冲击）
